scope: Real installer/uninstaller executable with compile-time sandbox registry key and workspace files; no real Chrome registration
checks: Missing .NET blocks installation without changing registration
Fresh per-user install writes exact two-origin manifest and Unicode paths
Repair replaces a corrupted payload and preserves original rollback state
Installed helper passes all six native protocol checks, including both allowed origins and rejection cases
Repair and uninstall refuse a running helper without terminating it
Missing ownership state blocks uninstall before file removal
Clean uninstall removes only its registration and files, preserving unknown files
Portable migration requires confirmation; repair retains backup; uninstall restores it
Uninstall preserves a registration taken over by another installation
Failure after registry write rolls registration back to its prior value
Failed repair restores installed payload bytes, managed registration and rollback state
Missing previous manifest removes owned registration instead of restoring a dangling path
Personal Chrome registration remains unchanged throughout isolated acceptance
